newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CHELSEA END 27-YEAR WAIT TO LIFT F.A. CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CHELSEA END 27-YEAR WAIT TO LIFT F.A. CUP.

text.p: Italian Roberto di Matteo's memorable first minute goal and an Eddie Newton volley seven minutes from time gave Chelsea a 2-0 win over Middlesbrough in a tense, closely fought English F.A. Cup Final on Saturday.
It was Chelsea's first Cup win since their only success in 1970 and meant defeat for Middlesbrough in both major domestic cup finals as well as relegation from the premier league this season.
Di Matteo opened the scoring after only 43 seconds with the fastest Cup final to be scored at Wembley in the 74 years that the final has been staged here.
Picking up the ball in his own half he ran 30 metres before unleashing an unstoppable 25-metre strike which flew in of the underside of Ben Roberts crossbar, giving the 21-year-old keeper no chance.
Newton clinched the victory, starting the move that led to the second goal. Ginafranco Zola made the final pass for Newton to volley home from close range.
Middlesbrough were unlucky when Gianluca Festa had a headed goal disallowed for offside just before halftime, but there was no doubting Chelsea's superiority and their deserved success.
